definitions.gloss: hanging advertisement in a train; overhead transit ad
definitions.explanation: An advertisement poster hung from the ceiling of a train car, positioned at eye level for standing passengers. A distinctive feature of Japanese public transportation.

examples.japanese: {電車|でんしゃ}の{中吊|なかづ}り{広告|こうこく}を{見|み}た。
examples.english: I saw a hanging advertisement in the train.

examples.japanese: {週刊誌|しゅうかんし}の{中吊|なかづ}り{広告|こうこく}が{目|め}に{入|はい}った。
examples.english: A hanging ad for a weekly magazine caught my eye.

examples.japanese: {中吊|なかづ}り{広告|こうこく}はデジタルサイネージに{置|お}き{換|か}わりつつあるが、まだ{紙|かみ}のものも{多|おお}い。
examples.english: Hanging train ads are gradually being replaced by digital signage, but there are still many paper ones.

notes:
CULTURAL NOTE:
A distinctive feature of Japanese trains. The posters are hung from horizontal bars near the ceiling, hanging at a height visible to standing passengers. Weekly magazines, new books, and event announcements are common subjects. The term is short for {中吊|なかづ}り{広告|こうこく}.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {中吊|なかづ}り{広告|こうこく} (hanging transit advertisement — full form)
- {電車|でんしゃ}の{中吊|なかづ}り (train hanging ad)
- {中吊|なかづ}りを{出|だ}す (to run a hanging ad)
